definition.scope: every tracked *.yml/*.yaml outside src/ and tests/ that parses as an OrcaFlex native model, an OrcaWave model or a modular spec

feature_kinds.section: top-level section (object type collection, e.g. Lines, VesselTypes, environment)
feature_kinds.key: key path with list indices collapsed and object-name maps collapsed to '*'
feature_kinds.value: enumerated option value of a solver setting (e.g. wave type, seabed model)

definition.excluded: object names, cross-references to named objects, free text and numbers
